styles.icon: Premium 3D app-icon render from one consistent icon set. One object, or one tight cluster, centered; three-quarter view from slightly above (camera elevation about 25 degrees, object turned about 20 degrees to the right), long lens with minimal perspective distortion. Materials only: glossy-matte vivid azure blue plastic (#3182F6), light blue (#8EC5FF), frosted translucent glass, smooth white ceramic, tiny brushed-silver details, and at most one small pale-peach (#FFC9B0) accent. Chunky rounded proportions with generous bevels, no sharp edges, no fine filigree. Lighting: large softbox key light from the upper left, soft fill from the right, subtle rim light, one soft contact shadow directly beneath the object. Background: perfectly flat pure white (#FFFFFF) edge to edge, no gradient, no vignette, no floor line, no extra props. The object fills about 70 percent of the frame with even margins and is never cropped. Clean, friendly, premium fintech-app icon style. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, currency symbols, logos, watermarks, faces, people or hands.
styles.object: Premium 3D illustration in the same material language as a fintech app icon set: glossy-matte vivid azure blue plastic (#3182F6), light blue (#8EC5FF), frosted translucent glass, smooth white ceramic, tiny brushed-silver details, at most one small pale-peach (#FFC9B0) accent. Rounded, chunky, friendly shapes with generous bevels. A small still-life scene of two to four objects, camera slightly above at about 25 degrees, long lens. Lighting: large softbox key light from the upper left, soft fill from the right, soft shadows falling toward the lower right. Background: exactly the flat color named in the prompt, seamless edge to edge, no vignette, no horizon line, no texture. Keep every important object inside the central 60 percent of the frame unless the prompt says otherwise. Calm, airy, generous negative space. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, currency symbols, logos, watermarks, screens with readable interface, faces, people or hands.
styles.still: Editorial 3D still-life render with a calm gallery mood. Matte white plaster and porcelain forms on a low rounded white plinth inside a seamless light cool-gray infinity cove (#F2F4F6) where floor and wall blend with no visible horizon. Soft large softbox light from the upper left, gentle bounce fill, soft long shadow toward the lower right, camera at plinth height with a 70mm lens, crisp focus on the subject with slight falloff behind. Exactly one accent: a thin glowing vivid azure blue (#3182F6) line or a translucent blue glass element; everything else white porcelain, plaster and cool gray. The subject sits inside the central 55 percent of the frame with generous empty space around it so 16:9, 4:3 and 1:1 crops all work. Any plaster face is a classical idealized cast fragment with blank pupil-less eyes like a Greek statue: no skin texture, no eyelashes, no hair, no makeup, no realistic person, no body, no blood, no surgical instruments. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, markings, logos or watermarks.
styles.space: Photorealistic architectural interior photograph of a generic, unbranded modern aesthetic clinic in Seoul. Full-frame camera, 24mm tilt-shift lens at 120 cm height, perfectly vertical lines, bright soft daylight (5200K) with subtle warm-neutral cove lighting, color-graded clean and airy: white walls, light oak, pale gray terrazzo or microcement, exactly one muted dusty-blue accent piece echoing #3182F6. Main furniture inside the central 60 percent of the frame, calm negative space near the edges. Completely empty: no people, no silhouettes, no reflections of people. No readable text, no signage, no logos, no brand names, no monitors or screens showing content, no posters or artwork with faces, no before-and-after imagery, no medical procedure, no surgical equipment, no needles. Magazine quality, natural color, high dynamic range, very subtle film grain.
